{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the contract premises
print("Dataset shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nUnique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("\nDuplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check assay_batch values
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("\nSample_seq max value:", df['sample_seq'].max())
print("Sample_seq value counts:\n", df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check patient_id duplicates
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple rows (re-tests): {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check if any patient has sample_seq > 1
retested_count = duplicate_patients['sample_seq'].max() > 1
print(f"\nDo any patients have sample_seq > 1? {retested_count}")"}
